More About Us Why choose us Our principles Achievements Why choose us PSMAS has a long history of success and professional service to its members dating back to over nine decades. The Society is rich with expertise and has stood the test of time and still continues to go further in bringing value to its members. For the past nine decades PSMAS has built a rich heritage and solid foundation in the healthcare sector in Zimbabwe as well as having a deeper understanding of its various stakeholders. Our principles We generate the necessary change in the healthcare industry by providing members with cost effective quality healthcare services and products.
